content.comment_body: Hi, I purchased a [company_name] PLC [article_no] to learn more about their products. I was under the impression that these devices could be programmed with [product_name] Portal. Can someone share more details about this?

Hello, this topic might be of use: [article_no] — [product_name], logic module, display PS/I/O: 12/24VDC/relay, 8 DI (4AI)/4DO, memory 400 blocks, modular expandable, Ethernet, integrated web server, data logging, supports standard microSD card, compatible with [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] or later. Older projects can also be executed.
[product_name] isn't programmable using [product_name] Portal. It requires its own software, [product_name] Soft Comfort. The current release is [version_no].
Where can I download [product_name] Soft Comfort?

A licensed release isn't available as a direct download, but demo and upgrade versions are. Upgrades require an existing installation or an original CD/DVD. For a fully licensed version, you need to make a purchase.
I recall once seeing something similar to the attachment, where I could add a [company_name] [product_name] using a button that then showed up in the interface.
No, I've never seen any feature related to [product_name] there. Programming requires [product_name] Soft Comfort (LSC).
If you remain unsure, you can start a Support Request and ask [company_name] for clarification directly.

As others mentioned, you need to purchase [product_name] Soft Comfort for [product_name]. The latest version ([version_no]) is available on DVD with order number [article_no]. [product_name] Portal is meant for [product_name] controllers, not [product_name]. For [product_name] support, contact the dedicated team.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion started with a user believing that [company_name] [product_name] PLCs could be programmed with [product_name] Portal, but multiple replies clarified that a dedicated software, [product_name] Soft Comfort, is required. The user appeared confused due to a previous encounter suggesting possible integration, but repeatedly it was explained that this isn't possible. If a licensed version of [product_name] Soft Comfort is needed, it must be purchased; only demo and upgrade downloads are available online.
